backend: Deployed Hono + Workers + D1 (managed inspection proxy)

checks.name: Signed-out landing does not expose dashboard or identity
Wrong password gives visible error without authenticated view
Password login loads authenticated dashboard and closes SDK dialog
Core screen contains exactly three specified areas and no worker analytics
Synthetic source and site timezone are visible in another browser timezone
SDK day tabs work by keyboard and retain full hourly coverage
Hourly forecast detail is keyboard-accessible without hover
Routine crew cards show grouped aggregates without worker identities
Forecast windows are readable and suggestions are advice, not recorded adherence
Dashboard renders at 1440px and 1920px with captured evidence
SDK setup dialog Escape closes and restores trigger focus
Site setup save is confirmed and survives browser reload
New crew is persisted and shown with explicit saved feedback
Assignment flow explicitly excludes private watch-local profiles
Simulated watch assignment saves without exposing identity in routine crew cards
Injected gateway loss is cautious and never reassures green
Explicit reconnect restores fresh labeled synthetic data
Named synthetic help is shown above the core information areas
Offline ACK stays visible; confirmed ACK hides banner but retains group help floor
Delayed help is identified rather than presented as immediate delivery
All three areas fit tablet and 390/360px mobile layouts without page overflow
Interactive buttons remain SDK-owned and native select controls are absent
Browser storage contains no synthetic emergency names or password
Logout clears protected view and server session across reload
No unexpected JavaScript runtime, console or CSP errors
